addons.name: Stremio Account Exporter
addons.description: Publicly hosted Stremio utility addon. Configure opens the local account exporter on the same computer.

manifest.name: Stremio Account Exporter
manifest.description: Local-first utility for exporting your Stremio profile, installed addons and library to a private JSON backup.

installNotes.stremio: Open the Stremio app using its stremio:// deep link.
installNotes.nuvio: Nuvio supports nuvio:// links for Stremio addon manifests.
installNotes.streamlet: Copy the HTTPS manifest URL and use Sources → Add Stremio addon → From URL.
